messages:
Priya Nair: Quick sync — we need to lock decisions for the reserved-pool roadmap slice slated for next sprint. Main asks: carryover rules, burst isolation, billing semantics during fallback, and on-call playbook.
Alex Chen: Can we enumerate the user stories we want to cover in the slice? Suggest 3: (1) deterministic burst expirer + visibility, (2) per-tenant admission caps, (3) graceful fallback with billing + webhook.
Maria Gomez: Add (4) short ops playbook for oncall: how to triage a noisy tenant and how to flip fallback thresholds. Customers need a single-source explanation.
Samir Patel: Implementation notes: expirer and admission caps are ~4d. Fallback routing + webhook is ~3d. Playbook + docs ~1d. Total ~2w with QA. We can heavy-scope down to an MVP of 1w by making fallback behavior conservative (manual trigger only).
Priya Nair: For contracts, customers ask for carryover of unused burst credits month->month. That's tricky for capacity planning. We could offer limited carryover (max 10% carryover, expires 30d). Thoughts?
Lara Kim: Acme & Beta customers prefer explicit carryover. 10%/30d seems fair. They also want a notice email when carryover is about to expire.
Alex Chen: Operational risk: carryover reduces pool elasticity. Proposal: enable carryover only for Tier 1 reserved pools (by opt-in) and reduce auto-burst buffer for those pools. Keep default no-carryover.
Dylan Park: From infra POV, opt-in toggle per pool is straightforward. But we must surface the current effective capacity in console and billing exports. That requires a small telemetry change (emit pool_effective_capacity).
Samir Patel: Telemetry change is 1d. We can include it in the MVP if we keep the fallback manual.
Maria Gomez: Billing question: If we route a request to shared-hosted during fallback, what price applies? Customer expectation differs: some expect reserved rate, others accept shared rate. We need policy + clear wording.
Priya Nair: Proposal: default policy = fallback billed at shared rate, but customers can opt-in to a paid fallback protection add-on (keep reserved pricing for fallback) if they purchase extra buffer credits. Document that in contract.
Lara Kim: Acme wants a grace behavior: send webhook + 2-minute buffer before auto-fallback when pool utilization crosses threshold, so they can throttle client-side if they choose. Can we do that?
Samir Patel: We can implement a short grace timer (2m) before automated fallback. It requires queueing and a timer per pool — small infra cost. I'll estimate 2d.
Alex Chen: Decision-needed items for sprint planning: 1) Carryover policy (enable opt-in 10%/30d for Tier1) 2) Billing policy (fallback = shared rate default; paid protection add-on) 3) Fallback mode (manual-first for MVP; auto with 2m grace for full release) 4) Telemetry shim (pool_effective_capacity + fallback_event tag).
Priya Nair: Which items must be in MVP (next sprint)? I vote: billing policy + manual fallback + telemetry shim (so CS can explain to customers). Carryover opt-in and auto-fallback with grace as follow-ups.
Maria Gomez: I agree. Customers want clarity on billing now; they can wait on carryover. So MVP = billing + manual fallback + telemetry + docs.
Dylan Park: I'll queue the telemetry shim ticket and add metrics names: `reserved.pool.effective_capacity`, `reserved.pool.fallback.count`, `tenant.admission.denied`.
Samir Patel: I'll build the manual fallback API (admin endpoint) and the webhook skeleton. I'll include a feature-flag so we can switch to auto-fallback later.
Lara Kim: I'll coordinate with Acme and Beta group for a pilot. I'll prepare the customer-facing doc and the webhook schema (short JSON with pool_id, timestamp, action).
Priya Nair: Quick poll: MVP scope lock? React :one: to lock (billing + manual fallback + telemetry + docs), :two: to include carryover opt-in in MVP.
ops-bot: poll created (1: MVP lock, 2: include carryover)
Alex Chen: :one:
Samir Patel: :one:
Maria Gomez: :one:
Dylan Park: :one:
Lara Kim: :two: (would like small carryover visibility if trivial)
Priya Nair: Tally looks like MVP-only. We'll keep carryover as a high-priority follow-up and scope a spike for it next sprint.
Alex Chen: Acceptance criteria for MVP: - billing policy doc + contract verbiage drafted - admin/manual-fallback endpoint in Canary with feature flag - telemetry events emitted and visible in dashboards - customer-facing FAQ and webhook schema - runbook entry for oncall.
Samir Patel: I'll open PRs and tag this thread. Will aim for canary by mid-sprint and pilot invite by Friday.
Priya Nair: Thanks all. I'll create the roadmap card and add owners + due dates. Re-check tomorrow 9:30am.
ops-bot: reminder: deploy freeze window upcoming Fri 02:00 UTC — schedule canary accordingly.
